KJV: Jethlah.
H3495:
Jithmah, an Israelite; from the same as 3490; orphanage;
KJV: Ithmah.
H3496:
Jathniel, an Israelite; from an unused root meaning to endure, and 410; continued of God;
KJV: Jathniel.
H3497:
Jithnan, a place in Palestine; from the same as 8577; extensive;
KJV: Ithnan.
H3498:
to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively to leave, cause to abound, preserve; a primitive root;
KJV: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.
H3499A:
properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free); from 3498;
KJV: abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.
